plan.title: Issue cockpit redesign v2: live-run IA — 6 tabs, crew spine, needs-you slot
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: The issue cockpit (IssueMissionControl.tsx) accreted 13 tabs plus a floating Tasks chip, with duplicated surfaces (Files vs Code both render ChangedFilesView; Activity vs Timeline both render ActivityTab), cost shown three times, and a '45 more' actions overflow. The page is not organized around the live run — the thing the operator actually comes to watch.
narratives.Proposal: Implement the v2 mockup (docs/design/issue-detail-redesign-mockup-v2.html, committed 96a9a9ad42): fold 13 tabs to 6 (Overview, Session, Plan, Changes, Activity, Discussion) with legacy-id deep-link mapping; add a NeedsYouSlot priority banner; restyle AgentsLane into the crew spine; rebuild the right rail (Now / Run details / Gates / Cost / Environment / Recent activity); redesign the header (cost exactly once); give the pipeline band truthful sublabels and live merge progress. Every removed surface is folded into a named new home — never dropped — with inventory.ts relocations and the no-loss test updated in the same change. Full decisions D1–D14, FR-1..13, NFR-1..5 in the PRD.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Console/drawer and rail densities are unchanged except inventory bookkeeping
- No new endpoints, polling loops, or stores (NFR-4)
- No changes to IssueActionMenu or the action registry (issueActions.ts)
- Stage/cockpit/OverviewTab.tsx is dead code — leave it untouched
- No Mintlify page additions (no Mintlify page documents cockpit tabs; state so in the PR description if still true)
- The v1 mockup (issue-detail-redesign-mockup.html) must NOT be implemented — it dropped surfaces
- No changes to the session tree lane collapse default or agent spawn flows

autoDecisions.summary: Adopted the canonical PRD on overdeck-state (drafts/pan-3356.md) as the implementation brief instead of authoring a new one, after re-verifying every file/line reference against the current tree.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body designates this PRD as the carrier of glossary, D1–D14, FR/NFR, and WI-1..13; all spot-checked references (TABS:71, ISSUE_DETAIL_TAB_IDS:66, default tab:415, tabBadge:407, header block:508–551, TasksDrawer:662, Pipeline Band:76, ISSUE_ACTION_DEFINITIONS:601, EXPECTED_COCKPIT_SECTIONS:136) verified accurate on 2026-07-31.

autoDecisions.summary: Lowered the xBRIEF as 13 items mapping 1:1 to PRD WI-1..13 rather than decomposing further.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each WI is already one focused, independently reviewable change; finer splits would separate tab removals from their relocation homes and break the same-commit no-loss invariant (D14), which is the audit gate for the whole redesign.

autoDecisions.summary: files_scope lists only files each item edits; reused-but-untouched components (ChangedFilesView, PrdViewer, DrawerArtifactsPanel, etc.) are excluded.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps scopes truthful and keeps the plan's projected surface at 20 distinct files — under the 25-file finalize lint — without hiding any real edit.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan-tab done/total count is computed from the shared ['plan', issueId] react-query cache (TasksPanel's existing query) instead of the PRD's original 'shared taskTotals rollup' phrasing.
autoDecisions.rationale: The CommandDeck taskTotals field is not reachable from the cockpit; the plan query cache is already shared, so this satisfies NFR-4 (no new fetching) with zero new plumbing.

autoDecisions.summary: Only tab-model-fold carries requiresInspection: true; all other items are false.
autoDecisions.rationale: tab-model-fold defines the MissionTab ids, LEGACY_TAB_MAP contract, and default-tab rule that five downstream items build on; every other item is a test-gated mechanical fold whose failure surfaces immediately in named component tests.

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/issue-view/NeedsYouSlot.tsx per PRD D10/WI-3 and export it from issue-view/index.ts. Source every input from IssueViewModel derivations (awaiting-input, stuck, troubled/paused, stale-review, blocker, pickup gate) — add a derivation to derivations.ts only if a field is missing; never query in the component (NFR-4). Render exactly one highest-priority item per the ladder awaiting-input → stuck → troubled/paused → stale-review → blocker (IssueBlockerSpotlight content) → pickup gate, amber tint 8%/32%, a '+N more' chip when several apply, and null when idle. Action buttons invoke registry entries (recoverAgent, purgeReview, unpause) via the existing action invocation helpers — no surface-local actions. Render the absorbed markers (Stale-review warning, IssueBlockerSpotlight, PickupGateCard escalation) as conditional data-section attributes. Wire the slot into the cockpit between header and pipeline band (one-line mount; the cockpit layout edit lands with the tab items). Write NeedsYouSlot.test.tsx covering ladder ordering, single-item rendering, +N count, null-when-idle, and registry-sourced actions.
